g.text: Williams & Tabas, 1995. Mechanism filled in by Borén 1998 (the binding site), Skålén 2002 (the decisive experiment) and Huang 2019 (the gate).

g.text: Rate-limiting step. Disable apoB’s proteoglycan binding and mice

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'Helvetica Neue', 'Helvetica', 'Arial', 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #2d6282

g.text: develop far less atherosclerosis at the same plasma LDL (Skålén 2002).
